topics.topic: Quranic Exegesis: Study, recitation, and legal rulings from Suratu-Nur (Quran 24:1-10)
learningObjectives: Recite verses 1-10 of Suratu-Nur adhering to standard rules of Tajweed and Waqf
Explain prescribed penal ordinances (Hadd) for fornication and adultery
Analyze the severe legal and spiritual consequences of Qadhf (false accusations of adultery against chaste women)

topics.topic: Quranic Exegesis: Suratu-Nur (Quran 24:27-35) on modesty, privacy, and the Verse of Light (Ayatun-Nur)
learningObjectives: Translate verses outlining protocols for seeking permission before entering homes (Isti'dhan)
Examine divine commands to lower the gaze (Ghaddu-Basar) and observe Islamic modest dress (Hijab)
Contemplate the profound metaphysical allegory of the Verse of Light (Allahu Nurus-Samawati wal-Ard)

topics.topic: Islamic Criminal Jurisprudence (Hudud and Qisas): Preserving society's five essentials
learningObjectives: Define Maqasid ash-Shari'ah: preservation of religion, life, intellect, lineage, and property
Explain categories of Islamic criminal penalties: Hudud (fixed statutory penalties), Qisas (retaliation), and Ta'zir (discretionary)
Evaluate the evidentiary safeguards and rigorous burden of proof required before imposing corporal penalties

topics.topic: Islamic Law of Inheritance (Mirath): Quranic shares and estate distribution principles
learningObjectives: Identify prerequisites prior to estate distribution (funeral costs, debts, and bequeathals/Wasiyyah capped at 1/3)
Classify legal heirs into Ashab al-Fara'id (stipulated share recipients) and Asabah (residuaries)
Calculate fractional shares for parents, surviving spouse, sons, and daughters under Quranic guidelines (4:11-12)

topics.topic: History of Islam in West Africa: Introduction and spread in Kanem-Borno Empire
learningObjectives: Trace trade routes across the Sahara facilitating Islamic penetration into the Lake Chad basin
Analyze the role of Mai Hume Jilmi (1085 CE) in declaring Islam the official state religion of Kanem-Borno
Examine the development of Quranic schools, Madrasahs, and diplomatic relations with North Africa

topics.topic: History of Islam in West Africa: Spread of Islam in Hausaland and Yorubaland
learningObjectives: Examine the Wangarawa traders from Mali and their role in introducing Islam to Kano and Katsina in the 14th century
Trace the entry of Islam into Yorubaland through old Oyo, known historically as 'Esin Imale'
Evaluate the scholarly and societal contributions of Islamic scholars in southwestern Nigeria

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Islamic Heritage Colloquium
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of Suratu-Nur exegesis, criminal jurisprudence, and West African Islamic history
Conduct practical problem-solving sessions on Islamic inheritance division calculations
Remediate historical dates and genealogical chronologies of West African empires

topics.topic: The 19th Century Jihad of Sheikh Usman Dan Fodio: Causes, execution, and Sokoto Caliphate
learningObjectives: Analyze the socio-religious and political corruption in Gobir that spurred Dan Fodio's reform movement
Trace the Hijrah from Degel to Gudu, declaration of Jihad, and military engagements against Hausa rulers
Evaluate the administrative, judicial, and literary achievements of the Sokoto Caliphate under Sultan Muhammad Bello

topics.topic: Contributions of Muslim Scholars to Global Civilization: Medicine, Mathematics, and Astronomy
learningObjectives: Examine the medical treatises of Ibn Sina (Avicenna) and surgical innovations of Al-Zahrawi
Analyze the mathematical breakthroughs of Al-Khwarizmi in founding algebra and algorithmic calculation
Highlight astronomical observations and optics research of Ibn al-Haytham during the Islamic Golden Age

topics.topic: Islam and Contemporary Challenges: Extremism, corruption, interfaith dialogue, and peace
learningObjectives: State Islamic condemnations against violent extremism, terrorism, and vigilantism
Explain the theological imperative for peaceful coexistence with non-Muslims based on Quran 60:8
Demonstrate the role of Muslim youth in combating corruption, promoting social justice, and national progress

topics.topic: Environmental Stewardship in Islam (Khilafah): Conservation of natural resources
learningObjectives: Explain humanity’s role as vicegerents (Khulafa) entrusted with the ecological preservation of the earth
Highlight prophetic injunctions against wasting water even when abluting by a flowing river
Promote animal welfare, afforestation, and responsible waste management as acts of Islamic worship

topics.topic: Comprehensive WASSCE/NECO IRS Revision & Past Question Marathon
learningObjectives: Review cumulative 3-year senior secondary IRS curriculum across Quran, Hadith, Shari'ah, and History
Execute timed speed drills answering 50 objective questions and 4 structured essay questions
Perfect Arabic textual quotation, translation accuracy, and jurisprudential reasoning in examination essays

topics.topic: Terminal Mock Examination and Broadsheet Certification
learningObjectives: Administer comprehensive mock WASSCE IRS examination papers under formal invigilation
Score answer scripts strictly according to WAEC marking guidelines and criteria
Certify final continuous assessment grades for graduation records and academic transcripts
